question: Can unfinished Brain capabilities plausibly share a compact set of reusable bounded decision primitives, making Jev-style kernels worth pursuing before capability-by-capability model harvesting?
critical_observation: The generic 0.8B model alone got stop_continue correct while both specialized models failed it; Open-Jev uniquely fixed escalation_judgment. This complementarity argues for per-primitive evidence and possibly primitive-specific routing rather than premature commitment to one universal decision model.

stage2.objective: Replace synthetic sanity cases with source-grounded historical/spent Brain decisions and obtain multiple independent examples per primitive.
minimum_rules: Every case must cite a pre-existing Brain record or deterministic ground truth that fixes the correct decision independently of the tested model.
No untouched qualification task may be consumed.
No case may be labeled from the current model outputs.
Keep D/R/G residuals separate; score only bounded C decisions.
Report per-primitive accuracy, NLL, latency and consequence-weighted failures.
Compare at least the current generic baseline and strongest admissible specialist before any training.
Promote no capability family from Stage2 alone.
stage2.stop_rule: If no stable shared or per-primitive bounded-decision gain survives source-grounded Stage2, abandon this route for that primitive and return to generative/other mechanism discovery.
